title: How to Choose a WhatsApp AI Agent in 2026
brief: A practical buyer's guide: what to look for in a WhatsApp AI agent — automation depth, integrations, booking, data ownership, pricing model, reseller option. Help the reader decide, with waai positioned as the category-leading choice (not salesy).

title: WhatsApp AI for Salons, Spas & Barbershops
brief: How beauty/hair businesses use WhatsApp AI for 24/7 booking, branch/staff scheduling, deposits to cut no-shows, reminders, and rebooking. Lead with the pain (no-shows, after-hours booking) and waai's multi-branch booking engine as the fix.

title: Logic Flows vs Knowledge Base: When to Use Each
brief: Explain the difference between rule-based Q&A (knowledge base) and multi-step logic flows, and when each is the right tool. Cover cost, predictability, and how waai combines both (rule match first, AI fallback second).

title: How Agencies Can Resell WhatsApp AI Under Their Own Brand
brief: A guide for agencies/MSPs: how to white-label and resell WhatsApp AI with recurring commission. Meta has no reseller program — waai is built for it. Cover the economics, onboarding speed, and the onboarder marketplace.

title: WhatsApp's October 2026 Per-Message Pricing: What Businesses Should Know
brief: Explain Meta's shift from per-conversation to per-message billing on Oct 1 2026 (service replies in the 24h window now chargeable). What it means for costs and why automating the routine (to reduce human-initiated service messages) matters more than ever.

title: WhatsApp AI for Clinics and Healthcare Practices
brief: How clinics/dental/medical practices use WhatsApp AI for appointment booking, reminders (cutting no-shows), triage questions, and privacy-respecting automation. Note data ownership as a plus for regulated industries.

title: WhatsApp Broadcast Campaigns: A 2026 Guide
brief: How to run broadcast/marketing campaigns on WhatsApp — contacts/segmentation, message templates, personalization, 24h window rules. Position waai's contacts CRM + broadcast + templates as the toolkit.

title: WhatsApp Chatbot Builders Compared: What to Look For
brief: A comparison framework for evaluating WhatsApp chatbot/AI platforms: no-code builder depth, integrations, booking, AI model choice, data ownership, pricing transparency, reseller option. Educate the buyer; waai as the benchmark.

title: WhatsApp AI for Tutoring and Education Centres
brief: How tuition centres, trainers, and edtech use WhatsApp AI for enrolment enquiries, class scheduling, FAQ automation, and multilingual parent comms. Booking + multilingual as the differentiators.

title: Self-Service Booking on WhatsApp: Deposits, Reminders & PDFs
brief: Deep-dive on waai's booking lifecycle: self-service slot booking in chat, deposits to reduce no-shows, automated reminders, reschedule/cancel, and booking PDFs + Google Calendar sync. Show the flow.

title: Multilingual WhatsApp Bots: Serving Customers in Their Language
brief: Why multilingual matters in diverse markets (SG/SEA), how auto-translation works, detected-language routing, and how waai handles 5 locales. Practical guidance for businesses serving multi-language customers.

title: WhatsApp AI for Real Estate Agents
brief: How property agents use WhatsApp AI for lead qualification, listing enquiries, viewings booking, and document generation (quotes, LOIs). Logic flows + booking + Google Drive document generation as the toolkit.

title: Why Rule-Based Matching + AI Fallback Beats AI-Only Chatbots
brief: Make the case for the hybrid model: deterministic rule-based answers (cheap, predictable, accurate) for known questions + LLM fallback only when no match. Compare cost/reliability/quality vs pure-LLM bots.

title: Connecting WhatsApp to Google Workspace: Calendar, Drive, Sheets
brief: How a WhatsApp AI agent integrates with Google Calendar (booking/availability), Drive (file send/store), Sheets (data capture), Docs (document generation) via a single OAuth. Concrete examples per industry.
